notes.title: Patch Notes: Inescapable Menu Bugfix
notes.notes:
Greeting dear S.U.B. players,

We heard some of you were having trouble controlling the menus (espescially the Options menu) using certain types of controllers, so we just released a new patch to (hopefully) fix these issues.

The patch allows for the default B-button on game controllers to escape these menus to return to the previous/main menu.

We hope this fixes these issues for you guys, and we'd love to hear back from you if it does or doesn't if you were experiencing these issues before (we have a Discussion page for bug reports if you want to contact us about them).

Kind regards,
Brametjuhh of team Spreadable Fruit
